name: Yayun Du
title: Assistant Professor
department: Electrical and Computer Engineering; SYMBIO-X Lab; Vanderbilt Institute for Surgery and Engineering
researchAreas: Adaptive robot control and reinforcement learning
fitReason: An explicit short-visit inquiry route and a software-centered HRI project direction make this worth a targeted feasibility check. Python/ROS, physiological-state inference and adaptive-controller evaluation support a CS-oriented research project, though the present lab also has a substantial bioelectronics focus and the publicly described summer project is simulation-based.

physicalEvidence.summary: First-authored UCLA-era ICRA 2022 work deploys MobileNetV2/TensorRT on Jetson Nano aboard the physical SAMBot and evaluates weed perception/control in North Dakota fields. The primary paper's affiliation is UCLA, so it does not establish current Vanderbilt robot access. Current SYMBIO-X interests connect sensing, ML and adaptive robots, but its Summer 2026 adaptive-HRI project explicitly uses simulation with no dependency on in-lab robot access; no completed Vanderbilt physical-robot learning trial was verified.

shortVisit.status: inquiry-only · 当前真机资源未确认
shortVisit.summary: The live SYMBIO-X opportunities page explicitly welcomes short- and long-term visiting students/researchers and gives a public email inquiry route. Its separate undergraduate/master's section also welcomes research interest. No eight-week duration, summer 2027 availability, or visitor funding commitment is stated. The university's specific 10-week Summer 2026 project listing is undergraduate-oriented and entirely simulated; it is research-scope evidence, not evidence external graduate visitors qualify for that program.

unknowns: Public physical-robot evidence predates the Vanderbilt lab. Do not transfer UCLA hardware or field infrastructure to Vanderbilt by assumption.
The Summer 2026 undergraduate listing is historical for summer 2027 and does not establish master's eligibility or an eight-week exception.
The lab's dated PhD application deadlines are degree admissions, not a visiting-student opening.

Vanderbilt permits a conditional foreign-degree J-1 Student Intern process, including unpaid internships, but host acceptance, degree objectives, sufficient support, insurance and institutional approval are still required. Personal/family-only funding was not conclusively verified in this pass.

J-1 Student Intern activities have restrictions on clinical positions and patient contact; a nonclinical software/simulation scope is the verified project direction. Remote participation under that US appointment is capped at 40%, which does not decide the rules for separate work performed entirely abroad.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
